title: 軟體弱點管理流程
summary: 以弱點風險、相依圖與修補放行串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect vulnerability risk, dependency graphs and patch acceptance with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 資產與風險
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「資產與風險」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop assets and risk through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 資產識別：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資產識別」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for asset identity.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「資產識別」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for asset identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資產識別」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for asset identity; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。
knowledge.textEn: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 200 個受影響資產中完成 170 個，覆蓋率為 85%；若另有 10 個盤點遺漏資產，真正分母為 210，覆蓋率降至 80.95%。覆蓋不是風險消除率，例子不使用實際弱點或目標。
knowledge.textEn: In a synthetic inventory, 170 of 200 affected assets gives 85% coverage. Ten missing assets change the denominator to 210 and coverage to 80.95%. Coverage is not risk-elimination probability; no real vulnerability or target is used.

quiz.question: 審查「資產識別」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for asset identity?
options: 主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「資產識別」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。
optionsEn: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets.
One matching output proves asset identity for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner.
quiz.explanation: 同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 因此「主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. The alternative "Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資產識別：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「資產識別」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for asset identity.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」；將結果與「同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Compare results against: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資產識別」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for asset identity; explain why this claim fails: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets.

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for asset identity?
options: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。
主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。
先把「資產識別」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。

steps.objective: 以「暴露面」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for exposure surface.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「在本地假想網路圖分開外部、內部及離線資產。」；將結果與「可達性與許可權前提會改變同一弱點的情境風險。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Separate external, internal and offline assets on a local diagram. Compare results against: Reachability and privilege prerequisites change contextual risk. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 在本地假想網路圖分開外部、內部及離線資產。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate external, internal and offline assets on a local diagram. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：分數相同的弱點都有相同營運風險。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal scores imply equal operational risk. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「暴露面」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「分數相同的弱點都有相同營運風險。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for exposure surface; explain why this claim fails: Equal scores imply equal operational risk.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 可達性與許可權前提會改變同一弱點的情境風險。
knowledge.textEn: Reachability and privilege prerequisites change contextual risk.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 在本地假想網路圖分開外部、內部及離線資產。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Separate external, internal and offline assets on a local diagram. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「暴露面」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for exposure surface?
options: 分數相同的弱點都有相同營運風險。
在本地假想網路圖分開外部、內部及離線資產。
先把「暴露面」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Equal scores imply equal operational risk.
Separate external, internal and offline assets on a local diagram.
Tune the displayed exposure surface result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 可達性與許可權前提會改變同一弱點的情境風險。 在本地假想網路圖分開外部、內部及離線資產。 因此「分數相同的弱點都有相同營運風險。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Reachability and privilege prerequisites change contextual risk. Separate external, internal and offline assets on a local diagram. The alternative "Equal scores imply equal operational risk." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 優先序：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「優先序」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for prioritization.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「優先序」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：利用證據、重要性與可補償控制共同決定順序。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用匿名情境比較同分不同暴露面的排序。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for prioritization. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Evidence, criticality and compensating controls jointly inform priority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Rank anonymous equal-score cases with different exposure. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 用匿名情境比較同分不同暴露面的排序。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Rank anonymous equal-score cases with different exposure. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有低分專案可永久略過。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All low-score items can be ignored permanently. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「優先序」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用匿名情境比較同分不同暴露面的排序。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for prioritization; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 利用證據、重要性與可補償控制共同決定順序。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence, criticality and compensating controls jointly inform priority.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 用匿名情境比較同分不同暴露面的排序。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Rank anonymous equal-score cases with different exposure. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「優先序」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for prioritization?
options: 所有低分專案可永久略過。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「優先序」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
利用證據、重要性與可補償控制共同決定順序。
optionsEn: All low-score items can be ignored permanently.
One matching output proves prioritization for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Evidence, criticality and compensating controls jointly inform priority.
quiz.explanation: 利用證據、重要性與可補償控制共同決定順序。 用匿名情境比較同分不同暴露面的排序。 因此「所有低分專案可永久略過。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Evidence, criticality and compensating controls jointly inform priority. Rank anonymous equal-score cases with different exposure. The alternative "All low-score items can be ignored permanently." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.
